Fletched Ammunition

You smooth each feather into place and sight down the finished shaft.

Rules

- ID: recipe-fletched-ammunition - Permission: Trail Workshop, Make Something Useful or Enchanting Workshop; the recipe alone grants no crafting permission - Tools: Craft tools - Materials per attempt: Suitable wood, feathers and binding, obtained in the scene or one compatible carried bundle use - Time per attempt: One hour - Result: Inventory supply, maximum d8

Roll the crafting card’s attribute. Weak raises one matching supply by 1 inventory step; Standard by 2; Strong by 3, up to the printed cap. The first step from out creates d4; later steps are d6, d8, d10, d12, d20. Check carried material supply after the attempt. No group crafting.
